data.name: Noorun
data.gender_notes: Noorun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Noorun is derived from the Arabic word 'noor', meaning light. It symbolizes guidance, hope, and illumination in the darkness. The name Noorun carries the meaning “Light of the World” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noorun usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, light is a metaphor for knowledge, wisdom, and faith. Noorun represents the enlightened path guided by Allah.
data.etymology: Noorun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noorun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نورون
in_arabic.long_meaning: النورون هو اسم مؤنث يعني النور والضياء والبهجة، يستمد من الجذر العربي ن و ر، وهو مشتق من نفس الجذر الذي يأتي منه كلمة نور، التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات، مثل آية النور في سورة النور، والاسم ي象ز الإشعة والضياء في الحياة

in_urdu.name: نورون
in_urdu.long_meaning: نورون ایک مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور چمک اور خوشی، یہ نام عربي الجذور ن و ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورة النور کی آية النور میں، اور یہ نام زندگی میں روشنی اور چمک کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: नूरुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरुन एक स्त्री नाम है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और चमक और खुशी, यह नाम अरबी मूल न و र से लिया गया है, जो कुरान में भी उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि सूरह अल नूर की आयत अल नूर में, और यह नाम जीवन में प्रकाश और चमक का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है

in_pashto.name: نورون
in_pashto.long_meaning: نورون د یو ښځینه نوم دی چې معنا یې ده رڼا او ځلا او خوشالۍ، دا نوم د عربي ريښې ن و ر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه په سورت النور کې د آیت النور، او دا نوم د ژوند کې د رڼا او ځلا استازیتوب کوي

in_english.name: Noorun
in_english.long_meaning: Noorun is a feminine name that means light and radiance and happiness, derived from the Arabic root n-w-r, which is also the root of the word nur, mentioned in the Quran in several verses, such as the verse of light in Surah An-Nur, and the name represents the beams and radiance in life

pronunciation.urdu: نورون کا تلفظ نو رون ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Noorun is not just an Arabic name, but it holds a significant place in Islamic culture. It is a name that represents the belief in the divine guidance and the role of prophets and holy texts in illuminating the path for followers (Muslims) in an often-chaotic and confusing world. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad is often referred to as "Samma'an ar-Rasheed" (the guide, the rightly-guided one) and "Noorun-Nabi" (the Prophet of light), emphasizing his role as the embodiment of guidance for Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Noorun is rooted in the Islamic concept of 'Huda' or guidance. It reinforces the belief in the presence of a divine power that guides and illuminates the path for individuals towards truth, wisdom, and ultimately, salvation. In Islamic teachings, the name Allah (God) itself is described as 'Nooran-Ladhee Noorun' (The Giver of Light, The Light of Lights), emphasizing the significance of light and guidance in Islamic spirituality. Noorun serves as a reminder of the guiding presence of Allah, providing solace in times of confusion and offering hope for a brighter future.
